objective: RRR GATE 4D-R3: diagnostico controlado de solo lectura posterior al workflow fallido 34422179209. Determinar exactamente cuantas de las 4 vistas Customer360 existen (0/4,1/4,2/4,3/4,4/4), cuales existen, su definicion registrada y si cada una puede consultarse con TOP 0. No ejecutar DDL ni DML. No modificar repositorio ni Produccion.
acceptance: reportar conteo exacto de vistas presentes sobre 4
reportar nombres exactos de vistas presentes
reportar definicion SQL almacenada de cualquier vista presente
validar SELECT TOP (0) de cualquier vista presente

queries.name: customer360_r3_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS user_name

queries.name: customer360_r3_presence_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS present_count, CAST(4 AS int) AS expected_count FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND v.name IN ('vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360')

queries.name: customer360_r3_present_views
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,v.name AS view_name,v.object_id,v.create_date,v.modify_date FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND v.name IN ('vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360') ORDER BY v.name

queries.name: customer360_r3_view_definitions
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,v.name AS view_name,m.definition FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON m.object_id=v.object_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND v.name IN ('vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360') ORDER BY v.name

queries.name: customer360_r3_activity_queryable
queries.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','V') IS NOT NULL SELECT TOP (0) * FROM dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial ELSE SELECT CAST('ABSENT' AS varchar(20)) AS status

queries.name: customer360_r3_score_queryable
queries.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','V') IS NOT NULL SELECT TOP (0) * FROM dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual ELSE SELECT CAST('ABSENT' AS varchar(20)) AS status

queries.name: customer360_r3_rank_queryable
queries.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','V') IS NOT NULL SELECT TOP (0) * FROM dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual ELSE SELECT CAST('ABSENT' AS varchar(20)) AS status

queries.name: customer360_r3_customer360_queryable
queries.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360','V') IS NOT NULL SELECT TOP (0) * FROM dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360 ELSE SELECT CAST('ABSENT' AS varchar(20)) AS status
